name: oxy-conditional-request-preflight-and-execution
instr:
Oxy cannot inspect an assembled middleware chain or produce an ordered, immutable request plan without serving traffic or changing observable state. Implement coordinated planning and atomic, at-most-once execution while preserving existing ServeHTTP behavior when coordination is unused.

Buffer, ConnLimiter, TokenLimiter, CircuitBreaker, RoundRobin, Rebalancer, forward, Tracer, and Stream must fully resolve execution decisions during planning. This includes size-constrained replayable buffering, untouched streaming pass-through, sticky or weighted selection, adaptive routing attribution, and outbound URL, protocol, host, and forwarding headers. Planning must not consume bodies or admission resources, run response buffering, call downstream or transport, commit HTTP responses, or change observable state. Rejections identify their participant and retain preceding decisions.

Execution validates every participant before any effect. Changed state returns `ErrStale`. Exactly one concurrent execution wins; later attempts return `ErrExecuted`. Admission atomically applies connection acquisition and every effective rate period, then releases the planned connection amount. The planned circuit route and backend control proxy derivation, transport, response attribution, and the single trace record. Existing uncoordinated responses, routing, rewriting, forwarding, streaming, limits, metrics, and tracing remain unchanged.
